It is contended on behalf of the accused-petitioners that no case for the alleged offences is made out against them and their incarceration is not warranted.

There are no factors at play in the case at hand that may work against grant of bail to the accused-petitioners and they have been made accused based on conjectures and surmises.
3.

Contrary to the submissions of learned counsel for the petitioners, learned Public Prosecutor opposes the bail application and submits that the present case is not fit for enlargement of accused on bail.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
5.

Upon consideration of the submissions that both the parties were agreeable for the marriage and that their wedding ceremony got celebrated and thereafter, the victim remained and habitated with her husband at her matrimonial home and [2023:RJ-JD:30650] (3 of 3) [CRLMB-11341/2023] after conception of a fetus of four months, an FIR got lodged, this Court deems it appropriate to allow the instant bail application.
The role of the petitioner-Amrit Lal is much lesser than that of petitioner-Govind.
There is high probability that the trial may take long time to conclude.
In light of these facts and circumstances, it is deemed suitable to grant the benefit of bail to the petitioner in the present matter.
Needless to say, none of the observations made herein under shall affect the rights of either of the parties during trial and this Court refrains from commenting on the niceties of the matter.

6. Accordingly, the instant bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is ordered that the accused- petitioners as named in the cause-titles shall be enlarged on bail provided each of Amrit Lal vs State Of Rajasthan (2023:Rj-Jd:30650) on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/121668661/
2 them furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Judge for their appearance before the Court concerned on all the dates of hearing as and when called upon to do so.
(FARJAND ALI),J 152-153-Ashutosh/-
